integrity_note: An exact rational Bernstein certificate and independent subspace recurrence support a new strict-convexity/uniqueness characterization. All already-published formulae and numerical estimates are attributed. Independent mathematical review is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Fully symmetric nonzero columns over the binary field, three information symbols, ideal with-replacement sampling and unrestricted span decoding only.
Continuum distribution optimum/finite-code infimum; exact finite-code attainment unproved.
No claim of global optimum among asymmetric codes or of higher-dimensional or peeling-decoder analogues.
The rational access expression and the numerical optimum were already reported by Wang and Yaakobi.
title: Unique interior degree distribution for three-bit symmetric random access
